Overview.Name: K.Hari babu
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: Vegetable dosa (1) & dal (1 small bowl)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (medium bowl) & curd (small cup)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & sambar & spinach curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (60 g) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & 1 chapati

Notes_and_Tips: Since overeating happens once you start eating, serve food in one fixed plate and wait before taking more.
Keep dinner balanced with protein and light rice portion to support digestion and sleep.
Spicy cravings can be satisfied through home cooked curries instead of outside snacks.
Focus on paneer and dal as main portions to support steady energy during desk work.
Simple consistent meals will help reduce stress and improve long term adherence.
